decisions.reason: Decision 2 says where a candidate goes and not who writes it, and the plan chose a reading without a clarifying record. The project allows a dated clarification note on an accepted record with the owner approval, so the plan now adds that note as increment A with its exact words, cites the draft-decision rule, and says the plan approval is the owner approval; the record body stays unchanged.

The criterion promised a repository-wide guarantee but the tests read only named files. Criterion 3 now names two tests that walk every shipped markdown file under base and packages outside tests, plus both specs, one in each module increment.

The generated root AGENTS.md was required to hold the new policy but appeared in no increment. It is now stated as regenerated by the owner rerender and carried by the install-state commit after each module increment, and increment D reads it and stops and reports if the sentences are missing.
Both test docstrings name the earlier plan as the work they carry out. Steps 1 of the groundwork and code-work increments now update the docstrings to name this plan and describe the rule under test.
